recentItems.title: ODEGAARD & HAVERTZ TAME THE LIONS | HIGHLIGHTS | Arsenal vs Chelsea (2-1) | Premier League
recentItems.description:
Kai Havertz and Martin Odegaard both grabbed brilliant goals as we came from a goal behind to earn yet another victory over London rivals Chelsea.

The win ensured we maintained our 100% start to the Premier League season, whilst extending our unbeaten record against the Blues to 12 games.
